# Identity

## In one sentence

In short, this company builds tools and training for teams who want to use AI safely. The founder writes most of the notes, and the team keeps them short and practical so that anyone can pick them up in one minute.

## What we do

We help small firms in Morocco and in France adopt AI without exposing client data. Our main brand is the training programme; the legal entity is a limited company based in Casablanca. Every week we review the pipeline, update the plan and write down what we learned.

The animal that survives everything is the mascot: it is small, patient and very hard to kill. This is the spirit we want in our work.
